name: undo
description: The shared acted-log: what agents, the assistant, watchers and modules did for the person, each with the inverse its own module declared, so one tap undoes it.

tools.name: undo.record
tools.summary: record an action with the inverse its module declared

tools.name: undo.list
tools.summary: list what was done on the person's behalf, newest first

tools.name: undo.run
tools.summary: undo one recorded action by running its stored inverse
